summary: Add a visible, offline-capable navigation entry from the existing Owner PWA to the already accepted Opal-hosted Mission Control, with a service-worker cache version bump so an installed PWA can refresh its shell.

evidence.primary_source: Owner confirmed Opal Mission Control v1.0.1 works from iPad mini/iOS 12 with WAN and Mac disconnected; existing Owner PWA shell is service-worker cached and the existing quick-links style is available.

expert_basis.relevance: Top-level navigation is not mixed content; this link navigates to the local Opal page instead of making an insecure fetch from the HTTPS Owner PWA.

validation: Focused Owner PWA package, offline shell reliability, and local-control fixture tests run after implementation; results recorded in the task report.
No live deployment, Opal, Matrix, AUX, Supabase, scoring, firmware, or router mutation is included.
evidence.rollback: Revert this source commit; the installed Opal Mission Control and current deployed Owner PWA remain unchanged until a separately authorized deployment.
